title: Obdavčimo najbogatejše: koliko prihodkov bi lahko prinesla obdavčitev bogatašev?
summary: Four scenarios for a tax on wealth above $100 million in Europe; for Slovenia a progressive wealth tax is estimated at over EUR 0.5 billion a year.

title: Stališča ZSSS na Predlog izhodišč za obdavčitev premoženja
summary: Union reply to the Finance Ministry consultation asking for a tax on the whole wealth of individuals, financial assets included, not only real estate.

title: Program stranke Levica 2022 (davek na celotno neto premoženje najpremožnejših)
summary: Election programme committing to a progressive tax on the whole net wealth of millionaires incl. real estate, shares and securities.

title: Tisočinka: prenovljeni davki na izbrano premoženje
summary: Real-estate association concept of a minimal tax on all wealth (about 0.1% natural persons, 0.3% legal entities). Not opened in full; the rates are quoted from a March 2026 Večer interview.
